title: Zero Array Transformation I
summary: Given an integer array nums and a series of queries, for each query, select a subset of indices within the specified range and decrement their values by 1.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a series of queries, for each query, select a subset of indices within the specified range and decrement their values by 1. Determine if it's possible to transform nums into an array where all elements are zero after processing all queries sequentially.
constraints: nums and queries each contain up to 100,000 entries.
Each query permits independently decrementing any subset of indices in its inclusive range by one.
Return whether available query coverage can supply every index’s required number of decrements.
reference_solution:
def can_make_zero_array(nums,queries):
    difference=[0]*(len(nums)+1)
    for left,right in queries:difference[left]+=1;difference[right+1]-=1
    capacity=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        capacity+=difference[index]
        if value>capacity:return False
    return True
